system.description:
Spending a banked Luck Point on a Skill Check adds +1 Talent Die instead of +1 Skill Die (only 1 Luck Point per check this way). When you spend Luck to turn the Doom Clock back, it goes back 1 extra minute.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.60
system.summary: Spending a banked Luck Point on a Skill Check adds +1 Talent Die instead of +1 Skill Die (only 1 Luck Point per check this way). When you spend Luck to turn the Doom Clock back, it goes back 1 extra minute.

when.label: Spent 1 Luck Point on this check (Talent Die instead of Skill Die)

automation.note: Tick the Jackpot bonus when you spend a Luck Point on a check (only 1 point per check converts). Right after spending Luck to turn the Doom Clock back (Clock It Back or two Luck symbols), Use Jackpot to turn it back 1 more minute.
